stage.presetHint: The safety preset bounds every agent — pick the least power the job needs.

readOnly.label: Read-only
readOnly.consequence: The agent can look but never change anything.

readPropose.label: Read + propose
readPropose.consequence: The agent proposes every change and a human approves each one before it runs — nothing is written directly.

readBounded.label: Read + bounded writes
readBounded.consequence: The agent can write inside its own workspace, nowhere else.

fullInScope.label: Full in-scope
fullInScope.consequence: The agent may write anywhere its grants allow — use with care.

routing.toolHint: Granted at the system level, inherited by sub-agents, narrowable per agent.
routing.artifactHint: Browse what you can access — your personal artifacts, your domain’s, and anything added from the Marketplace — and choose per-artifact access. Read marks it queryable; Write (needs approval) marks writes as held-for-approval; Write (direct) is direct write, builder-only.
routing.enforcementHint: The builder-gate on Write (direct) is enforced at save and re-checked against the owner’s current role at run time (a demoted owner’s direct writes fall back to held-for-approval). These data/knowledge/metric capabilities are also enforced in the offline Build-verification gateway. On the live cluster, data/knowledge/metric access takes effect through the system’s tool grants, OPA policy, run-as-user rights and dataset-level security — per-artifact live enforcement is a labelled follow-up. Connections below are enforced live per call today.

routing.connHint: Browse the connections you can access and grant per-connection capability. Probe to verify: granted Read → allow, non-granted → deny, Write (needs approval) → held for approval in Governance.
routing.routingHint: The default an agent uses when it isn’t pinned to a specific tier. Cheap-first: light work → Standard, deep reasoning → Reasoning. A per-activity override here — Standard or Reasoning — writes the system’s routing config, applied on Build.
routing.runtimeNote: Not yet in effect when a team runs: each agent runs on its own model (Strong, Standard or Auto, set on the agent), and Build registers only those models for this system.
routing.directWriteNote: Direct write (no approval) is builder-only — grant “Write (needs approval)” to route writes through Governance.
